desc: the frame folded into an n-sided kaleidoscope

params.name: sides
params.help: how many mirror sectors — 2 is a simple fold, 12 a tight mandala

params.name: zoom
params.help: pull the source wide or lean in close; bass breathes it

params.name: spin
params.help: how fast the whole pattern rotates — 0 holds still

params.name: drift
params.help: 0 locks the mirror axis to centre; up it wanders slowly, keeping long runs alive
